content.title: Will There Be A Season 5 of 'Dark Winds' on AMC?
content.text: Published April 5, 2026, 5:30 p.m. ET Malcolm In The Middle: Life Is Still Unfair - Trailer0 seconds of 1 minute, 45 secondsVolume 0% It seems like only yesterday that the fourth season of Dark Winds debuted on AMC. Sadly, the show’s latest eight-episode adventure is about to come to an end, with the season finale airing tonight (April 5) on AMC. If you don’t want to wait until tonight, the show’s Season 4 capper is now available on AMC+, which offers a free trial for new and eligible subscribers. You can also add AMC+ to your Prime Video account for an additional $7.99/month (with ads) or $10.99/month. The streamer is currently offering a discount, $4.99 or $2.99 (with ads), for the first two months. Dark Winds Season 4 concludes tonight, but what does the future hold for this beloved fan favorite? Has Dark Winds been renewed for Season 5? Will Dark Winds Season 4 find its way to Netflix? Here’s everything we know. What Time Is The Dark Winds Season 4 Finale on Tonight (April 5)? The season finale of Dark Winds, “Ni’ Hodisxǫs (The Glittering World),” airs tonight at 9:00 p.m. ET on AMC. Don’t want to wait until tonight? No problem! The episode is now available to stream on AMC+. You can watch AMC live with an active subscription to DIRECTV, Philo, Sling TV, or YouTube TV. How Many Episodes Are There of Dark Winds Season 4? Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEThe fourth season consists of eight episodes. Will There Be a Season 5 of Dark Winds? Yes! Not only did AMC announce a fifth-season renewal in February, but production on the new season in Santa Fe, New Mexico, has already started. “Over four seasons, Dark Winds has masterfully blended compelling character-driven stories, Navajo culture, spirituality and breathtaking cinematography,” Chief Content Officer of AMC Networks and President of AMC Studios Dan McDermott said in a statement. “We are elated to continue the journey alongside showrunner John Wirth and the incomparable Zahn McClarnon. Our extraordinary producing and creative team, cast and crew have crafted a gripping crime drama that continues to be embraced by fans and widely celebrated by critics. We can’t wait to share more of this incredible story with audiences across the globe.” It was also announced that Martin Sensmeier has joined the cast in a series regular role, playing, per Deadline, a former Vietnam vet turned racetrack worker with ties to Chee from middle school. No official release date has been announced, but we expect the new season to debut on AMC in early 2027, with our best guess being February or March. How To Watch Dark Winds Season 4 On AMC+: You can stream Dark Winds on AMC+, which is available for $7.99/month. You can also purchase an ad-free option for $10.99/month or $109.99/year. You can sample the service with a seven-day free trial. Additionally, you can add AMC+ to your Prime Video account for an extra $7.99/month. Amazon is currently offering a discounted rate, $4.99 or $2.99 (with ads), for the first two months. Is Dark Winds On Netflix? Yes! The first three seasons of Dark Winds are currently streaming on Netflix. Will Dark Winds Season 4 Be On Netflix? There’s no official information as to if/when the current season of Dark Winds will be on Netflix. The third season of the series premiered March 9, 2025, on AMC and debuted October 27, 2025, on Netflix. If the show follows a similar pattern, you can expect the fourth season to drop on the streamer in September or October of 2026. Tags AMC+ Dark Winds zahn mcclarnon
